page.layout: One printed page: an engraved portrait of Ramus within an oval frame. Inscriptions run around the frame: top centre, left side, right side and bottom. Show-through from the reverse, a handwritten note at the foot and handwriting in the left margin are not transcribed.
page.notes: The engraving shows a bald, bearded man in profile, turned to the left, in a ruff and a gown, one hand resting on a book, with putti in the corners of the frame. The frame inscriptions are partly cut off and only partly legible: "NIA VINCII" on the left, "RAMVS ETA[T]" on the right, "LABOR" at the bottom, "FE:" at the top, with a "IV" or "VO" fragment near the lower corners, which I could not read with certainty. Faint mirrored text of the title on the reverse is show-through and is not transcribed. The handwritten note at the foot and the manuscript in the left margin are not printed text.
